info.title: API.SH: Takealot
info.description: The Takealot API from API.SH: public Takealot data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Takealot's departments (no params) or the categories under a department or category, each with its id, name, link slug, product count and whether it has subcategories. Use the ids as `department` and `category` in /takealot/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/takealot-categories

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: A department id to list its categories (e.g. 13).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id (with its department) to list its subcategories.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Takealot product: title, subtitle, brand, price, list price, badges, offer type (fastest delivery, lowest price), free shipping, preorder, stock status with warehouses and lead time, loyalty prices (eBucks, Discovery Miles), credit offer, the seller (name, VAT status, rating), every other offer with its seller, price and stock, rating and star distribution, breadcrumbs, description, specifications, highlights, images and the original record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/takealot-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A PLID such as PLID94928735 (the `id` in search results), or a takealot.com product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of one Takealot product: rating, title, text, the reviewer's first name as shown, date, time after purchase, helpful votes and variant. 10 a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/takealot-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A PLID or takealot.com product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: helpful (default) or latest.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars, 1-5.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Takealot (South Africa) product search with every filter the shop offers: plid, tsin, link, title, subtitle, brand, authors and formats (books, media), price (lowest and highest offer), list price and saving, rating, review count and star distribution, badges, stock status with the warehouses that hold it, preorder flag, shipping message and image. `facets` lists every filter for the query (departments, deal types, stock regions, price bands, brands, ratings, delivery times and product attributes) with counts; `suggestions` and `related_searches` come with it. 36 products a page; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (null on the last page). Without `q`, give a department, category, brand, deal or promotion to browse.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/takealot-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords (optional when browsing a department, category, brand, deal or promotion).

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: A department id from /takealot/v1/categories (e.g. 13 for Computers & Tablets).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id from /takealot/v1/categories?department=... (e.g. 27404 for Laptops).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only these brands (comma-separated, as in the Brand facet, e.g. HP,Lenovo).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in rand.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in rand.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-4.

parameters.name: in_stock_region
parameters.description: In stock at the warehouse for cpt (Cape Town), dbn (Durban) or jhb (Johannesburg).

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Delivery time: in_stock, 3_days or 7_days.

parameters.name: deal
parameters.description: A deal type from the Deal facet (e.g. Featured Deals).

parameters.name: promotion
parameters.description: A promotion id (from a deals page link) to list its products.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: new or refurbished.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other facet as Name:value pairs from `facets` (filter name and value), separated by `;`, e.g. CpuType:Intel Core i5.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, newest.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass back `next_cursor` for the next page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search suggestions Takealot shows while typing: the suggested queries with any department or category they point to.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/takealot-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
